name: Profile CSS injection
summary: A user pastes CSS or HTML into a profile field, and the page takes the new style.
how: Paste the CSS in the field that the site allows.
Set a wallpaper on the page with a fixed position.
Set the boxes to 60% to 80% opacity.
Hide or move site ads and default parts only when the site allows it.

origin.note: Myspace allowed users to add their own HTML and CSS to a profile.

adoptions.via: Myspace members restyle their profile pages with pasted code.
